event.name: DevFest Kisumu 2026
event.tagline: Building the Future with AI, Cloud & Open Technologies on the Equator
event.theme: Next-Gen Tech: AI Agents, Cloud Scale & Sustainable Innovation

venue.name: Ciala Resort & Conference Centre
venue.address: Kajulu Hills Road, Off Kisumu - Busia Highway, Kisumu

speakers.name: Dr. Achieng Odhiambo
speakers.role: Principal AI Researcher & Google Developer Expert (ML)
speakers.bio: Dr. Achieng is a leading researcher in multilingual natural language processing and multimodal AI architectures for African languages. With over a decade of research, she has spoken at NeurIPS and Google I/O.

speakers.name: Brian Otieno
speakers.bio: Brian designs hyper-scale transactional pipelines and zero-downtime distributed systems serving over 30 million active digital financial users daily across East Africa.

speakers.name: Faith Mwende
speakers.role: Senior Android & Flutter Lead | WTM Ambassador
speakers.bio: Faith is a passionate mobile developer and active Women Techmakers Ambassador. She specializes in offline-first architectures, declarative animations, and performant cross-platform mobile apps.

speakers.name: Kevin Omondi
speakers.bio: Kevin specializes in offensive security, cloud workload protection, and DevSecOps pipelines. He mentors ethical hacking enthusiasts across universities in Western Kenya.

speakers.name: Brenda Awuor
speakers.role: Open Source Lead & Web Platform Engineer
speakers.bio: Brenda is a champion of the open web and community organizer. She has guided hundreds of student developers into contributing to global open source projects and modern web standards.

speakers.name: Samuel Kiprono
speakers.bio: Samuel develops petabyte-scale data mesh platforms, streaming telemetry pipelines, and Lakehouse architectures using Apache Iceberg, Spark, and BigQuery.

speakers.name: Juliet Nekesa
speakers.role: Head of Product Experience & Design Systems
speakers.bio: Juliet advocates for accessibility, emotional design, and high-fidelity user research. She has spearheaded design transformations for prominent pan-African educational and logistics products.

speakers.name: Dennis Munene
speakers.bio: Dennis merges low-power microcontrollers with edge machine learning to build real-world environmental monitors and aquaculture sensor grids along the shores of Lake Victoria.

speakers.name: Mercy Chebet
speakers.bio: Mercy is an award-winning mentor who empowers underrepresented engineers into global engineering roles, remote international internships, and venture-backed founder paths.

speakers.name: Emmanuel Ochieng
speakers.bio: Emmanuel helps engineering teams across EMEA and Africa implement multi-agent workflows, fine-tune Gemini models, and build low-latency RAG architectures.

agendas.title: Registration, Welcome Breakfast & DevFest Expo
agendas.description: Check-in, collect your DevFest Kisumu 2026 swag kit, enjoy tea and refreshments, and connect with community partners and student developer booths.
agendas.prerequisites: Confirmation QR code or Ticket ID

agendas.title: Opening Ceremony: Celebrating 12 Years of GDG Kisumu & Tech Growth
agendas.description: Welcome remarks from the GDG Kisumu and Women Techmakers lead team, setting the vision for DevFest 2026 and recognizing local tech ecosystem milestones.

agendas.title: Keynote: The Frontier of Multimodal AI & Autonomous Agents in Sub-Saharan Africa
agendas.description: A comprehensive exploration of how multimodal foundational models and autonomous reasoning agents are transforming healthcare, agricultural yields, and multilingual digital public infrastructure across Africa.

agendas.title: Lake Victoria Morning Tea, Group Photo & Booth Exhibitions
agendas.description: Network over refreshments, visit sponsor showcases, and participate in the official DevFest Kisumu 2026 group photo outside the pavilion.

agendas.title: Building Resilient FinTech Microservices with Kubernetes and GCP
agendas.description: Step inside Safaricom's architectural playbook: managing tens of millions of financial transactions per second, multi-region failover, chaos engineering, and zero-trust service mesh.
agendas.prerequisites: Familiarity with Docker, cloud infrastructure, and microservices

agendas.title: Flutter 4.x & Dart: Crafting Ultra-Fluid Cross-Platform Experiences for Emerging Markets
agendas.description: Learn how to build lightweight, battery-efficient Flutter mobile applications that run smoothly on budget devices with spotty internet connectivity. Covers Impeller graphics and offline caching.
agendas.prerequisites: Basic understanding of Flutter or mobile app development

agendas.title: Zero-Trust Architecture & Securing Cloud-Native APIs in 2026
agendas.description: Real-world threat modeling for cloud APIs: OAuth 2.1 hardening, mutual TLS, automated supply chain vulnerability scanning (SLSA), and runtime threat detection with eBPF.
agendas.prerequisites: Familiarity with REST APIs and basic cloud concepts

agendas.title: Designing for the Next Billion Users: Accessible UX and Inclusive Design Systems
agendas.description: Translating cultural nuances, low-bandwidth affordances, and multi-lingual voice interactions into cohesive, scalable design systems for African consumer applications.

agendas.title: Lunch Buffet, Swag Exchange & Community Networking
agendas.description: Enjoy a traditional lakeside buffet, connect with hiring partners, exchange badges, and participate in lightning mentor speed-dating sessions.

agendas.title: Hands-on Lab: Fine-Tuning Open Source LLMs & RAG Pipelines with Vertex AI
agendas.description: Bring your laptop! We will build an intelligent document assistant utilizing Gemini 2.0 Flash embeddings, vector search, and custom tool calling with Python and Vertex AI.
agendas.prerequisites: Laptop with Python 3.10+ and a Google Cloud account (free credits provided at venue)

agendas.title: Smart Agriculture on Lake Victoria: Edge AI & LoRaWAN Sensors for Fisherfolk
agendas.description: A field-tested demonstration of deploying ESP32 microcontrollers, solar-harvesting edge sensors, and underwater water-quality probes delivering real-time alerts via USSD and SMS.
agendas.prerequisites: Interest in electronics and embedded systems

agendas.title: Real-Time Lakehouse Analytics with Apache Iceberg & BigQuery
agendas.description: How modern data teams unify streaming transactions and batch reporting into open table formats. Learn how Iceberg avoids vendor lock-in and slashes query costs by 65%.
agendas.prerequisites: Basic understanding of data warehouses and SQL

agendas.title: Panel: Navigating Tech Careers, Global Remote Work & Open Source from Western Kenya
agendas.description: An inspiring, no-holds-barred conversation with leaders who built international tech careers right from Kisumu, Kakamega, and Eldoret. Discussing compensation, contracts, mental health, and giving back.

agendas.title: DevFest 2026 Awards, Hackathon Winners & Closing Ceremony
agendas.description: Recognition of standout student projects, women-in-tech contributors, quiz tournament awards, raffle prizes (Chromebooks, Google swag, cloud vouchers), and farewell toast.
